preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= m for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge color ci must be between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of colors connecting each pair of vertices for each query, separated by newlines.
